init_hook: # Source .env files from this repo + the litellm-langfuse-stack if present.
# Operators can override LITELLM_LANGFUSE_STACK to point at a checkout elsewhere.
# Use a quick 'foreman' alias that points mix at the right host.
# Tell Elixir to print a banner on shell entry so the operator knows which fork they're in.

info: echo "Foreman dev environment"
echo ''
echo 'Stack repo:   $LITELLM_LANGFUSE_STACK'
echo 'Foreman API:  $FOREMAN_API_URL'
echo ''
echo 'Quick commands:'
echo '  devbox run setup    first-time: copy .env, install deps, fetch mix deps'
echo '  devbox run up       bring up Langfuse stack + otel-collector (the full dev stack)'
echo '  devbox run down     tear down dev services (keep volumes)'
echo '  devbox run reset    tear down + drop volumes (destructive)'
echo '  devbox run ps       show service status for both repos'
echo '  devbox run logs     tail all logs (Langfuse stack + otel-collector)'
echo '  devbox run server   start the Phoenix server (foreground)'
echo '  devbox run iex      start the Phoenix server with iex'
echo '  devbox run db:migrate    run ecto migrations'
echo '  devbox run db:reset      drop + re-migrate the dev database'
echo '  devbox run test     run all ExUnit tests'
echo '  devbox run test:langfuse  run only the :langfuse-tagged integration tests'
echo '  devbox run test:unit   run ExUnit tests EXCEPT the :langfuse ones'
echo '  devbox run deps     fetch + compile mix dependencies'
echo '  devbox run fmt      format the Elixir code'
echo ''
env:list: echo 'Cluster services (verify after devbox run up):'
echo '  langfuse-web:      http://127.0.0.1:3000 (UI + public REST API)'
setup: # First-time bootstrap. Idempotent — safe to re-run.
test -d "$LITELLM_LANGFUSE_STACK" || { echo "litellm-langfuse-stack not at $LITELLM_LANGFUSE_STACK"; echo 'Clone it: git clone <repo> $LITELLM_LANGFUSE_STACK'; exit 1; }
echo 'setup done. Next: devbox run up'
up: # Bring up the full dev stack: litellm-langfuse stack + foreman's otel-collector.
# Order matters: the langfuse web service must be reachable on the
# compose network before otel-collector starts (it forwards Basic-auth
# traces there). depends_on handles this in compose, but the stack
# must be up first so the external network exists.
echo '== waiting for langfuse-web to be reachable =='
if curl -sf -m 2 http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/public/health > /dev/null; then echo "  langfuse ready in ${i}s"; break; fi;
down: cd "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT" && docker compose -f ops/otel-collector/docker-compose.yml down 2>&1 || true
reset: # DESTRUCTIVE: drops all volumes. Requires confirmation.
echo 'This will DROP all volumes (langfuse metadata, litellm virtual keys, etc.)'
cd "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT" && docker compose -f ops/otel-collector/docker-compose.yml down -v 2>&1 || true
ps: cd "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT" && docker compose -f ops/otel-collector/docker-compose.yml ps 2>&1 || true
logs: cd "$DEVBOX_PROJECT_ROOT" && docker compose -f ops/otel-collector/docker-compose.yml logs -f otel-collector
db:reset: cd packages/foreman_server && mix ecto.drop && mix ecto.create && mix ecto.migrate
